reviews.title: How does this app help anyone?
reviews.text: My 10 year old son is an avid fisherman. Found this app via Google looking for fishing spots. WARNING they have tricky misleading subscription tactics. Backing up on click immediately with another that appears you are acknowledging confirmation of the first $.99 trial but actually luring you (pun intended) into a premium subscription $27.99. The information offered for fishing spots was so basic and included 4 locations that are gated and private so you would never be able to access them. Thumbs down.

reviews.title: Completely disappointed misleading app

The reason I downloaded the app and paid $35 for a year premium subscription was for the Navionics maps which was falsely advertised as included in the app. 
I was suckered as you have to pay  for an additional yearly subscription fee of $25 for the maps
Also to note the app has the wrong species lists on the water bodies in my area, it listed white sturgeon in a local lake which is a 100% impossible and walleye in a  shallow pond nearby 😂

reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.text:
It’s a great app to find the place that’s not over fished, it helps with what baits you should use, how the bite is going to be and when the best time to fish is.
IF YOU PAY FOR PREMIUM YOU CAN HAVE ALL THE WONDERFUL THINGS IN THE WILLY WONKA FACTORY. HOWEVER THERES NO GOLDEN TICKET, AND THIS IS REAL LIFE. THE THING ABOUT REAL LIFE IS NOT EVERYBODY CAN AFFORD OR PAY FOR A SUBSCRIPTION AND I UNDERSTAND YOUR A BUSINESS AND HAVE BILLS TO PAY. Couldn’t you make a free app that shows the hot spots of local fishing area’s and even make the app kinda like FB where the anglers can chat with one another, share picks and it’s Totally free. You as a company could ask for donations to keep that app free, make a tackle shop (affordable tackle) hold mini tournaments in the app, make the entry fee like $1-$10 this to would help you as a whole company. I believe anglers would talk about this app and it would spread like wild fire and possibly out do you premium app. Some people feed their families by fishing, some families go hungry, it’s easier to get a free phone with free WiFi than it is to have enough money to buy their family something to eat. I do think you have a wonderful brand here, and would also be willing to help with making it better at no cost to you other than a free app. Just think about it.

reviews.title: Predatory, Complicated Cancellation Process
reviews.text:
Don’t use the free trial unless you plan to pay $30 for a mediocre app with no way of cancelling the trial other than contacting Fishbox directly. I got more information using state’s GIS map and looking at Google reviews, so I won’t even get any benefit from the $30 they stole from me. Couldn’t access my account to cancel my subscription despite trying every method listed in the FAQ, Help sections. I scoured both the app and website- but every time I would attempt to log in (as a user or guest) or access my subscription info, it would say there was an error and to try again later. I’ll be contacting my bank to have the charge removed and I’d report them to the BBB if I thought it would do anything.
EDIT: I was offered a $5 gift card and told they weren’t allowed to refund the charge due to their “recently updated” terms. After I posted this review, I received my refund. Like I said: predatory.

reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text: Just another app luring you into paying a monthly subscription. This one asks you about 30 personal questions and then “generates” the map and proceeds to prompt you to pay a subscription to go any further. I don’t see why I would pay a subscription for an app that has improper grammar in one of the questions. “I don’t know when the fish is biting”. What happened to allowing a free option with less privilege? I’m not jumping into bed with subscription services with no test drive.

reviews.title: Unauthorised charge
reviews.text: Read carefully terms and conditions as this app charges you even if you won’t open account with them. They charged me after one year of not using the app and after reporting unauthorised charges, they refunded only 50% explaining that the rest of my money gone for some taxes and charges. One big SCAM!

reviews.title: Was good but now not so much
reviews.text: I had been using Fishbox for almost 2 years escpecially the Navionics Depth Map while boating that rocked! But after an update last July I never see the depth levels anymore only one layer. Still had an active Navionics subscription- sent multiple emails to support which they said we are aware of this and are working on a solution. Now 8 months later still the same look and no solution. Time to move on from Fishbox…. Disappointed,

reviews.title: Stupid money hungry snakes
reviews.text: This app is absolutely useless, all the info it gives is basic public knowledge anyone can find out for free. I payed $1 with the expectation it was a one time charge which it said it was. Come to find out the charged me $40 with no warning. It’s impossible to get to talk to anyone real to get a refund. This app is for you if you would like to get scammed and then played around with by an ai chat bot. I wouldn’t recommend to even the most novice angler. STAY AWAY AT ALL COSTS.

reviews.title: Deceitful billing
reviews.text: I wanted to create a map of the surrounding fishing waters, so I ended up on this app/website. I agreed to pay a one time $1 payment for the map. Once I put in my card details it tried to get me to upgrade the plan multiple times. I hit the button that said “skip trial” and I was billed $27 instantly. The way they have the trials worded and set up is so deceitful, they said it set up to trick you into subscribing for a monthly payment. NO ONE USE THIS APP. The map did not even make me my map, and it provides very little useful fishing information.

reviews.title: Subscriptions
reviews.text: I had a subscription with these guys for a couple months and the app was very tricky to work. I didn’t feel like it was correct in any of the information it gave us and a little overpriced for what you get with the app. I canceled my subscription and was then charged three months later after my subscription was canceled and was informed that my subscription was active in two separate places when I was never informed of this. It’s very frustrating to be misleading by a company.
